name: M M Rubber Company Limited
about: M M Rubber Company Limited manufactures and markets foam and other related products. The company provides organic natural latex, latex hybrid, and foam mattresses; natural latex, latex hybrid, and polyfibre pillows; and accessories, such as mattress protector and topper, travel pillow, and coccyx and haemorrhoid cushions. It offers its products under the MM FOAM brand. M M Rubber Company Limited was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
